title: Tech stocks today: Meta lays out new AI path, Intel to sell $15 billion in stock
excerpt: Tech stock news for the week of Aug. 10
content_html:
Tech stocks closed out a mixed day on Monday, as Meta (META) CEO Mark Zuckerberg laid out his vision for the future of AI and Intel announced it will sell $15 billion in stock.

Meta stock was flat on the day.

In his manifesto, Zuckerberg emphasized building out AI for all.

"Some argue that superintelligence itself or a small set of experts who control it should decide what is best for humanity. We disagree. The history of democracy and economics has shown that there is no single objective answer to how people define the best life, and therefore the best approach is letting people decide what matters in their own lives," he wrote.

Zuckerberg also announced the company's new Muse Glimmer, an open-weight model that users can download and run on their own devices.

Intel (INTC), meanwhile, said it will sell $15 billion in common stock to help fund its growth as it continues to see demand for its chips as a result of the AI boom.

On the earnings front, Supermicro (SMCI) and CoreWeave (CRWV) will report their results after the bell on Tuesday.

content_html_zh:
周一，科技股收盘涨跌不一，Meta (META) 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 阐述了他对人工智能未来的愿景，英特尔宣布将出售 150 亿美元的股票。

Meta 股票当天持平。

扎克伯格在宣言中强调为所有人构建人工智能。

“一些人认为，超级智能本身或控制它的一小群专家应该决定什么对人类最有利。 我们不同意。 民主和经济学的历史表明，对于人们如何定义最好的生活，没有单一的客观答案，因此最好的方法是让人们决定自己生活中重要的事情，”他写道。

扎克伯格还宣布了该公司的新 Muse Glimmer，这是一种开放式模型，用户可以在自己的设备上下载并运行。

与此同时，英特尔 (INTC) 表示，由于人工智能的蓬勃发展，对其芯片的需求持续增加，该公司将出售 150 亿美元的普通股，为其增长提供资金。

在盈利方面，Supermicro (SMCI) 和 CoreWeave (CRWV) 将于周二盘后公布业绩。
